about: The usual time from picking a flag up at the spawn to arriving at the stand, by hall and side: the median over single runs that were captured, not pushed, and not carried by a player with Shadow of Haste (that flag mechanic, since removed from the game, brought a flag in within seconds: a median of 14 s against 29 s). The test of pushing the flagger reads a pushed flag against it (30% later, R-427). Rebuild with `jobs.py bench <file from moments.py all>`.
